say:4:1721924003:1.text: Y-Yes, that's right! Wait... are you Lady Silvie?
say:4:1721924003:1.source_cn: 正、正是！您、您就是茜茜夫人？

say:5:1721924004:1.source_cn: 两位误会了。我叫克萝伊，茜茜夫人是我的座上宾，目前正暂...

say:6:1721924005:1.text: As for my relationship to her... you might say I serve as her guardian, in a sense.

say:8:1721924007:1.text: W-We made it ourselves... and we put a great deal of care into it... I really hope she likes it.

say:9:1721924008:1.text: Mm... Good materials. Nicely put together. And this feather... excellent texture. Soft, responsive, just enough spring to it.

say:10:1721924009:1.source_cn: 我想，夫人一定会满意的。

say:11:1721924010:1.text: Lady Silvie, your visitors have arrived.

say:24:1721927029:1.text: Go on, then. What do you want to know about my friend Pearl? After everything you've done for me, I suppose I can be generous.

say:0:1721937001:0.text: It's almost dusk. We should go find Lady Silvie.
say:0:1721937001:0.source_cn: 时间快到黄昏了，我们去找茜茜夫人吧。
say:0:1721937001:0.male: It's almost dusk. We should go find Lady Silvie.
say:0:1721937001:0.female: It's almost dusk. We should go find Lady Silvie.

say:1:1721938001:1.text: You've got everything? Good. Then listen carefully.
say:1:1721938001:1.source_cn: 东西都准备好了？很好。现在听我指挥。

say:2:1721938002:1.text: Mage, your job's easy. When the time comes, put those three trinkets into the water nice and gently. No splashing, no fumbling. Do it like you're making an offering to a queen.
say:2:1721938002:1.source_cn: 魔法师，你的任务很简单。把这三样东西，轻柔地丢进水里。...
say:2:1721938002:1.male: Mage, your job's easy. When the time comes, put those three trinkets into the water nice and gently. No splashing, no fumbling. Do it like you're making an offering to a queen.
say:2:1721938002:1.female: Mage, your job's easy. When the time comes, put those three trinkets into the water nice and gently. No splashing, no fumbling. Do it like you're making an offering to a queen.

say:3:1721938003:1.text: And you, Aiden, stay back and play that happy little song you wrote for Pearl. Put some feeling into it this time. I want energy. I want warmth.
say:3:1721938003:1.source_cn: 至于你，阿德里安。你就站在后面，用你最大的力气、最饱满...

say:4:1721938004:1.text: And make it sound happy! If I hear even a trace of that sad little whiny tone, I'll claw your face off!
say:4:1721938004:1.source_cn: 记住，要快乐！如果让我听到一丝哭腔，我就把你挠成花脸！

say:6:1721938006:1.text: And one instrument won't be enough. Mage, when the song really gets going, you join in too. Sing, use magic, clap—whatever works. I want the whole river to feel it!
say:6:1721938006:1.source_cn: 还有，光靠一把琴可能不够热闹。魔法师，等他弹到高潮的时...
say:6:1721938006:1.male: And one instrument won't be enough. Mage, when the song really gets going, you join in too. Sing, use magic, clap—whatever works. I want the whole river to feel it!
say:6:1721938006:1.female: And one instrument won't be enough. Mage, when the song really gets going, you join in too. Sing, use magic, clap—whatever works. I want the whole river to feel it!

say:7:1721938007:1.text: I'll be up front waiting for her. And until I say so, neither of you comes any closer while Pearl and I have our private... no, intimate conversation. Got it?
say:7:1721938007:1.source_cn: 我会在最前面等着。记住，在我允许之前，谁也不许上前打扰...

choice_prompt:8:1721938007.text: I'll be up front waiting for her. And until I say so, neither of you comes any closer while Pearl and I have our private... no, intimate conversation. Got it?
choice_prompt:8:1721938007.source_cn: 我会在最前面等着。记住，在我允许之前，谁也不许上前打扰我和珍珠的私人……不，私密谈话。懂了吗？

say:9:1721938008:0.text: Good. Then let's get started. Make this a concert she won't forget!
say:9:1721938008:0.source_cn: 很好。行动开始！让这场愉快的黄昏音乐会，开演吧！

say:1:1721940001:1.text: Alright, girl talk's over. Here. Pearl wanted you to have this.
say:1:1721940001:1.source_cn: 闺蜜谈话结束了。喏，这是珍珠托我带给你的回礼。

say:2:1721940002:1.text: Th-That's my family badge! The one I lost. I told her how upset I was over it... so she'd been keeping it for me this whole time?
say:2:1721940002:1.source_cn: 这……这是我弄丢的家族徽章！我曾经因为丢了家族徽章向她...

say:3:1721940003:1.text: According to her, it was too heavy and a pain to drag around, so she figured she might as well give it back.
say:3:1721940003:1.source_cn: 她说，这东西太沉了，压得她游不动，正好还给你。

say:4:1721940004:1.text: Oh, and she wanted me to tell you this: She's the kind of fish who follows her whims, and right now she's off on a grand tour of the Savannah canal. She doesn't belong to any one pond, and she refuses to be tied down by anybody's tears.
say:4:1721940004:1.source_cn: 还有，她让我转告你：她是一条像灵感和快乐一样自由的鱼，...

say:5:1721940005:1.text: And one last thing. She said, "Aiden, stop crying. Your music's lovely. Next time, play something happy."
say:5:1721940005:1.source_cn: 她的最后一句话是，阿德里安，不要再流眼泪了。你的琴声很...

say:6:1721940006:1.text: I get it now... I really do.

say:7:1721940007:1.text: This is enough. The badge tells me everything I needed to know. She cared. She listened. She understood...
say:7:1721940007:1.source_cn: 这就足够了。这枚徽章告诉我，她真的倾听过我，理解过我，...

say:8:1721940008:1.text: I can't keep holding on to her just because I didn't want to be alone. If she wants to be free, then... I have to let her be free.
say:8:1721940008:1.source_cn: 我不能那么自私，为了自己的慰藉而绑住她。既然她是自由的...

say:9:1721940009:1.text: Thank you, Lady Silvie. And... thank you too, Magister. You helped me get something precious back.
say:9:1721940009:1.source_cn: 谢谢您，茜茜夫人。也谢谢您，阁下。是你们让我找回了珍贵...
say:9:1721940009:1.male: Thank you, Lady Silvie. And... thank you too, Magister. You helped me get something precious back.
say:9:1721940009:1.female: Thank you, Lady Silvie. And... thank you too, Magister. You helped me get something precious back.

say:10:1721940010:1.text: I should go. I'm going to practice, and when she comes back someday, I'll have a happy song ready for her!
say:10:1721940010:1.source_cn: 我要走了。我要回去重新把琴练好，等她旅行回来的那天，再...

narration:11:1721940011:0.text: Aiden leaves looking lighter than he has in a long time, as if he's finally let something go.
narration:11:1721940011:0.source_cn: 阿德里安走了，他的身影比以往任何时候都要轻松，似乎放下...

narration:12:1721940012:0.text: Before he goes, you make sure to change him back.
narration:12:1721940012:0.source_cn: 当然，在他走之前，你没有忘记把他变回来。
narration:12:1721940012:0.male: Before he goes, you make sure to change him back.
narration:12:1721940012:0.female: Before he goes, you make sure to change him back.

narration:13:1721940013:0.text: And yet, touching as the moment is, something about it starts to bother you...
narration:13:1721940013:0.source_cn: 感动之余，你也察觉到了一丝怪异……
narration:13:1721940013:0.male: And yet, touching as the moment is, something about it starts to bother you...
narration:13:1721940013:0.female: And yet, touching as the moment is, something about it starts to bother you...

say:0:1721941001:0.text: The three trinkets. The concert at dusk. Did any of that actually do anything at all? Something's off.
say:0:1721941001:0.source_cn: 三颗珠子的献礼和黄昏音乐会……真的有用？怎么想都不太合理。

say:0:1721941001:0.female: The three trinkets. The concert at dusk. Did any of that actually do anything at all? Something's off.

choice:5:1:2.female: So she didn't care about him at all?
